ideas: AI is the study of rational agents.
Search, logic, probability and learning are core tools.
The fourth edition puts beneficial machines into the very first chapter.
Safety and ethics are part of the subject, not an add-on.

args.a: A broad toolkit approach is the best way to learn AI.
args.c: Some say the field is now dominated by deep learning, so the classic material matters less.

args.a: AI should be built to be provably beneficial.
args.c: Most deployed systems do not yet follow this approach.
